metadata.description: Your assistant for French paperwork: track your documents, deadlines and renewals.

dashboard.title: My documents
dashboard.subtitle: Upload your French paperwork, our AI will handle the rest.
dashboard.empty: No documents yet. Upload your first document to get started.

documentsNew.title: Add a document
documentsNew.description: Upload a document and our AI will identify it for you.
documentsNew.dropzoneHint: PDF, image or scan, 10 MB max

duplicateName.title: This document already exists
duplicateName.description: A file with the same name is already saved in your space. Rename your file before sending it, or delete the old document.

duplicateContent.title: This file has already been uploaded
duplicateContent.description: This file's content is identical to a document already in your space, even though the name is different. Check your documents before adding a new one.

fileType.title: This file type is not accepted
fileType.description: Only PDF, PNG and JPG files can be uploaded. The file's content is checked, not its name: renaming a file is not enough to make it valid.
